lines.text: Many learners say: You should do an effort to learn.
Better: You should make an effort to learn.
We make an effort. We do not do an effort.
Make! You should make an effort to learn.

data.wrong: You should do an effort to learn.
data.right: You should make an effort to learn.
data.why: We make an effort. We do not do an effort.
